description: This file defines the class ResourceExplorer2Client for AWS SDK, used for interacting with the AWS Resource Explorer service. It includes method signatures for various operations related to resource views, indexes, and tags.

classes.name: ResourceExplorer2Client
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Resource Explorer service, extending the generic AwsClient class.

methods.name: associateDefaultView
methods.description: Associates the default view with the resource explorer.

methods.name: associateDefaultViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates the default view with the resource explorer.

methods.name: batchGetView
methods.description: Retrieves multiple views in a batch operation.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates a new index for resource discovery.

methods.name: createView
methods.description: Creates a new view for resource exploration.

methods.name: disassociateDefaultView
methods.description: Removes the association of the default view.

methods.name: disassociateDefaultViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes the default view association.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific index.

methods.name: getManagedView
methods.description: Gets details of a managed view.

methods.name: listIndexesForMembers
methods.description: Lists indexes for members within a resource group.

methods.name: listResources
methods.description: Lists resources in the resource explorer.

methods.name: listSupportedResourceTypes
methods.description: Lists resource types supported by AWS Resource Explorer.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search within the resource explorer.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateIndexType
methods.description: Updates the type of an index.
